name: Goethe-Zertifikat A1: Start Deutsch 1
scoring_en: The three written sections give 45 raw points and the speaking section gives 15. Both are scaled so that the written part counts 75 and speaking counts 25 of 100. A total of 60 passes. Scaling factors and the exact pass rule are marked unverified until checked against the current Durchführungsbestimmungen.

sections.name: Hören
task_types_en: Short everyday dialogues, choose the correct picture or statement
Telephone messages and recorded information, choose the correct option
sections.note: Item split across the three tasks to be confirmed.

sections.name: Lesen
task_types_en: Two short texts such as emails, true or false
Small ads or notices, choose the one that fits the situation
Signs and notices, true or false

sections.name: Schreiben
task_types_en: Fill in five fields of a form for another person
Write a short personal message or email covering three given points
sections.note: Task 1 counts 5 points, task 2 counts 10 points. Item count treats the letter as one item.

sections.name: Sprechen
task_types_en: Ask for and give information on a topic using word cards
Make and respond to requests using picture cards
sections.note: Group exam, duration depends on group size. Minutes and points need checking.

source_note: Structure from the public exam description. Numbers not yet checked against the current edition are flagged in section notes.
